title: 京王杯ジュニアSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Keio Hai Junior Stakes, the track where Sakura Bakushin O vies for public attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Intent on bowing out of running sprints with a dazzling finale—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O strides onto the course with vigor.
